description: Submit one asynchronous video generation task through the MiniMax Mavis gateway and return its task_id; poll it with mavis_query_video. MiniMax-H3 supports 4-15 seconds with native audio and accepts keyframe or reference sets; MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3 supports 6 or 10 silent seconds from text or a single first frame. Submission is non-idempotent and consumes quota: an uncertain failure must not be submitted again.

inputSchema.description: Asynchronous video submission parameters. Keyframe inputs (input_image with optional last_frame_image) and reference sets are mutually exclusive.

model.description: Target model. MiniMax-H3: 4-15 seconds, 768P or 2K, native audio. MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3: 6 or 10 silent seconds, 768P or 1080P.

prompt.description: Video description: subject, motion, camera and, for H3, the sound the clip should contain.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. MiniMax-H3 accepts 4-15; MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3 accepts 6 or 10.

input_image.description: First frame or keyframe image: a public HTTP(S) image URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> image resource of the current session.

last_frame_image.description: Closing frame image, MiniMax-H3 only and only together with input_image.

reference_type.description: Role of input_image. MiniMax-H3 accepts first_frame, last_frame or subject; MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3 accepts first_frame, or subject at 6 seconds.

reference_images.description: Reference images, MiniMax-H3 only, up to 9 entries. Reference sets are mutually exclusive with keyframe inputs.

items.description: A public HTTP(S) image URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> image resource of the current session.

reference_videos.description: Reference videos, MiniMax-H3 only, up to 3 entries; supply the matching durations in reference_video_durations.

items.description: A public HTTP(S) video URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> video resource of the current session.

reference_video_durations.description: Duration in seconds of each reference video, in the same order and with the same length as reference_videos.

reference_audios.description: Reference audio tracks, MiniMax-H3 only, up to 3 entries; they cannot be used without a reference image or video.

items.description: A public HTTP(S) audio URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> audio resource of the current session.

resolution.description: Output resolution. MiniMax-H3 supports 768P and 2K; MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3 supports 768P and 1080P, and 10 seconds only with 768P.

ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, MiniMax-H3 only; adaptive is required for keyframe mode and is the default for reference sets.
